verdict.reasons: Core identity and packaging match hold: the white-and-blue upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll is present and branded correctly, with one expected commercial product and no mixed or wrong family. However, the candidate falls just short of the required quality score because the installed laterals are shown as ordinary black tubing rather than clearly flattened drip tape, and the scene lacks localized root-zone wetting; both are technical evidence mismatches. Minor advisory issues (secondary fine print not fully legible at scene scale, a small package-to-soil clearance, and a black drip gun accessory in the field) are noted but do not constitute core defects.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
